title: RNK Curator API Mapping
description: A translation rule between two loader APIs. Formalizes the APIMapping shape used by the Tync's APIMapperRegistry.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract the entry conforms to.

sourceApi.description: Fully-qualified source API element (class, method, or event).

translation.description: Human-readable description of the semantic translation.

expression.description: Optional formal rewrite: how a source call site maps to target call sites.

sourceLoader.description: Loader of the source API (forge, fabric, neoforge, paper, spigot, ...).

minecraftVersions.description: Version scope of this mapping; empty/omitted means version-agnostic.
